facts.fact: Medafrica Systems (Medasys) inaugurated the Maroc Datacenter at Temara on 19 September 2017, described by the Ministry as a cloud computing platform offering managed services to SMEs, large companies and public administrations; the page says it was designed according to the Tier III standard, with no certification stated.

The Ministry of Industry's page describes Medafrica Systems (Medasys) as a Moroccan multi-subsidiary company that inaugurated the Maroc Datacenter at Temara on 19 September 2017, a cloud platform on a '100% Moroccan site'; it calls the company Moroccan but gives no ownership shares, and says the project was initiated and funded in partnership with Morocco SME under the Imtiaz programme.

systems.owner: planned joint venture of Medasys and Zircom Group (UK)
